title: Mean score
task: Set result to the mean score across all trials, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Mean score per arm
task: Set result to a Series of mean score per arm, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by arm.

title: Std per arm
task: Set result to a Series of std (ddof=1) of score per arm, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by arm.

title: Arm sizes
task: Set result to a Series of counts per arm, sorted by arm.

title: Median score
task: Set result to the median score across all trials, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Score range
task: Set result to the range (max − min) of score, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Highest-mean arm
context: Which treatment scores best on average?
task: Set result to the arm (str) with the highest mean score.

title: Sex balance
task: Set result to a Series of trial counts per sex.

title: Average satisfaction
task: Set result to the mean satisfaction across survey, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Satisfaction per plan
task: Set result to a Series of mean satisfaction per plan, rounded to 3 decimals, sorted by plan.

title: Responses per region
task: Set result to a Series of response counts per region.

title: Satisfaction distribution
task: Set result to a Series of counts per satisfaction score (1-5), sorted by score.

title: Average response
task: Set result to the mean response across patients, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Average BMI
task: Set result to the mean bmi, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Doses used
task: Set result to a sorted list of the distinct dose values in patients.

title: Dose vs response
context: Does more dose mean more response?
task: Set result to the Pearson correlation between dose and response, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: BMI vs response
task: Set result to the Pearson correlation between bmi and response, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Overall conversion rate
task: Set result to the overall control conversion rate = total control conversions / total control visitors, rounded to 4 decimals.
hint: sum conversions / sum visitors for control.

title: Treatment conversion rate
task: Set result to the overall treatment conversion rate, rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Normal CDF
task: Set result to the standard-normal CDF at 1.5, rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Binomial probability
task: Set result to P(X = 5) for X ~ Binomial(20, 0.14), rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Response std
task: Set result to the sample std (ddof=1) of response, rounded to 3 decimals.

title: 90th percentile score
task: Set result to the 90th percentile of score, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Standardise a score
task: Set result to the z-score of 70 using the trials score mean and std (ddof=1), rounded to 3 decimals.

title: Top-box satisfaction
task: Set result to the percentage of survey responses with satisfaction == 5, rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Score by sex
task: Set result to a Series of mean score per sex, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by sex.

title: Oldest patient age
task: Set result to the maximum age in patients (an int).

title: Score IQR
task: Set result to the IQR (Q3 − Q1) of score, rounded to 2 decimals.

title: Poisson probability
task: Set result to P(X = 4) for X ~ Poisson(2.5), rounded to 4 decimals.

title: Days tracked
task: Set result to the number of distinct dates in ab_daily (an int).

title: Total visitors
task: Set result to the total visitors across all ab_daily rows (an int).

title: Score skewness
task: Set result to the skewness of score, rounded to 3 decimals, using scipy.

title: Low satisfaction count
task: Set result to the number of survey responses with satisfaction <= 2 (an int).

title: Average response per dose
task: Set result to a Series of mean response per dose, rounded to 2 decimals, sorted by dose.
